Santa Teresa Benedita da Cruz (Edith Ste: Saint Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein)
Filósofa judia convertida ao catolicismo: A Jewish philosopher who converted to Catholicism, a Carmelite and martyr.

Fundador dos Salesianos, educador de men: Founder of the Salesians, an educator of poor boys with the preventive method (reason, religion and love).
Nascido em 1815 no Piemonte (Itália), or: Born in 1815 in Piedmont (Italy), he was ordained a priest in Turin, where he took in abandoned youths. He founded the Salesians and, with Saint Maria Mazzarello, the Daughters of Mary Help of Christians. He died in 1888.
Os mais pobres e doentes, devoção no Bra: The poorest and the sick, devotion in Brazil.
Primeira santa nascida no Brasil, conhec: The first saint born in Brazil, known as "the good angel of Bahia".
Maria Rita de Sousa Brito Lopes Pontes n: Maria Rita de Sousa Brito Lopes Pontes was born in Salvador in 1914. A religious sister, she dedicated her life to the poor and the sick and founded the Irmã Dulce Social Works. She died in 1992 and was canonized on October 13, 2019.
Muito invocado por jovens e no mundo dig: Much invoked by young people and in the digital world (popular title, not official).
Jovem apaixonado pela Eucaristia que uso: A young man passionate about the Eucharist who used computing to spread Eucharistic miracles.
Nascido em Londres em 1991 e criado em M: Born in London in 1991 and raised in Milan, he died of leukemia in 2006, at the age of 15. He was beatified in 2020 and canonized in 2025.
Mães, esposas e quem reza pela conversão: Mothers, wives and those who pray for the conversion of family members.
Modelo de perseverança na oração: rezou: A model of perseverance in prayer: she prayed for years for the conversion of her son, Saint Augustine.
Nasceu em Tagaste (norte da África) por: Born in Tagaste (North Africa) around 331. She died in Ostia, near Rome, in 387, after seeing Augustine's conversion.

Doutor da Igreja, autor de \"Noite Escur: Doctor of the Church, author of "Dark Night" and "Spiritual Canticle".

Creio em Deus Pai todo-poderoso, criador: I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth; and in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died and was buried; he descended to the dead; on the third day he rose again from the dead; he ascended into heaven, and is seated at the right hand of God the Father almighty; from there he will come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.
Pai nosso, que estais no céu, santificad: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name; thy kingdom come; thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
Ave Maria, cheia de graça, o Senhor é co: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
Glória ao Pai, ao Filho e ao Espírito Sa: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
Ó meu Jesus, perdoai-nos, livrai-nos do: O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, lead all souls to heaven, especially those in most need of thy mercy.
Salve, Rainha, Mãe de misericórdia, vida: Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy, our life, our sweetness and our hope. To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve; to thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us; and after this our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God, that we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ. Amen.

Nasceu Saulo em Tarso (atual Turquia) e: He was born Saul in Tarsus (present-day Turkey), a Pharisee and persecutor of Christians. Around the year 36 he saw a vision of Christ on the road to Damascus and converted. He made several missionary journeys around the Mediterranean, founding communities and writing letters. According to tradition, he was martyred in Rome by beheading, between the years 64 and 67.
